headline_pain: Can't Pay Rent AND a Mortgage?
headline_outcome: No Repayments Until You Move In
primary_text: "If I buy off the plan, when do I actually start paying? I can't afford rent AND a mortgage at the same time." This is the number one question we get — and the answer is good news. When you buy off-the-plan, you pay a deposit to secure your warehouse. Your mortgage doesn't start until settlement, which happens when construction is complete and you're ready to move in. That means no double payments. You keep paying rent at your current space until your new Truganina warehouse is built, then you transition straight from renting to owning. One payment stops, the other starts. Simple. Get the full payment timeline today.
description: Zero mortgage repayments until construction is complete and you settle
